TECHS.blurb: Autocast (50 mana, no cooldown): when an army with a Warlock starts a battle, every blow has a 5% chance to strike twice as hard.

TECHS.name: Fiery Weapons II
TECHS.blurb: Fiery Weapons: a 10% chance of a double blow.

TECHS.name: Fiery Weapons III
TECHS.blurb: Fiery Weapons: a 15% chance of a double blow.

TECHS.name: Scouting Pyre
TECHS.blurb: A Warlock lights a pyre where he stands (3 seconds of casting, 25 mana). For 1 minute it sees every neighboring province in its line of sight. 1-minute cooldown per Warlock.

TECHS.name: Fire Trap
TECHS.blurb: A Warlock buries a fire trap in his province (3 seconds of casting, 50 mana). The next enemy army to enter any part of that province is engulfed: 150 damage that ignores armor, to its front line. One trap per Warlock.

TECHS.name: Blazing Trap
TECHS.blurb: Fire traps deal 300 damage.

TECHS.name: Molten Trap
TECHS.blurb: Fire traps deal 450 damage.

TECHS.name: Sacred Pyre
TECHS.blurb: A Warlock standing in one of your provinces raises a Sacred Pyre there (3 seconds of casting, 100 mana and 200 wood). For 1 minute that province makes 110 more gold every 10 s. Then the nation waits 3 minutes.

TECHS.name: Path of Fire
TECHS.blurb: A Warlock fires up his army (50 mana): 100% faster for 10 seconds. 1-minute cooldown per Warlock.

TECHS.name: Path of Flame
TECHS.blurb: Path of Fire: 125% faster for 15 seconds.

TECHS.name: Path of Inferno
TECHS.blurb: Path of Fire: 150% faster for 20 seconds.

TECHS.name: School of the Elements
TECHS.blurb: Commit to Elemental magic: rock armor, whispering rocks, forest spirits, town portals and a grand elemental of living water.

TECHS.name: Rock Armor
TECHS.blurb: Autocast (50 mana, no cooldown): when an army with a Druid starts a battle, plates of stone gather round it: a shield worth 10% of the army’s total health soaks up the damage before any soldier is hurt.

TECHS.name: Whispering Rocks
TECHS.blurb: A Druid raises whispering stones on a mountain border of the province he stands in (3 seconds of casting, 25 mana): both provinces on either side are in sight for 1 minute.

TECHS.name: Town Portal
TECHS.blurb: After 3 seconds of casting (100 mana), a Druid and the army he is in are carried to your capital. 5-minute cooldown per Druid.

TECHS.name: Forest Spirit
TECHS.blurb: A Druid channels a Forest Spirit into the province he stands in: while he keeps it up, the province makes twice the gold, wood, food and research. It drains 1 mana a second, and he regains none meanwhile.

TECHS.name: Grand Elemental
TECHS.blurb: A Druid summons a towering man of living water for 2 minutes (3 seconds of casting, 100 mana): 500 health, no armor, 50 damage a swing. He joins the Druid’s army (or forms one), fights, and can capture provinces. 5-minute cooldown per Druid.

TECHS.name: Cracked Skulls
TECHS.blurb: Warlocks with a wand can hold a Cracked Skull in the off hand: +1 attack, and the Fireball casts 2 s faster. Set it in the Armory.

TECHS.name: Polished Skulls
TECHS.blurb: Warlocks with a wand can hold a Polished Skull in the off hand: +2 attack, and the Fireball casts 4 s faster.

TECHS.name: Flawless Skulls
TECHS.blurb: Warlocks with a wand can hold a Flawless Skull in the off hand: +3 attack, and the Fireball casts 6 s faster.

TECHS.blurb: Costs 1000 gold to begin. When finished, your school and all of its spells are forgotten, and you can choose a new school.

TECHS.blurb: A Mage looks through a border of trees beside him (3 seconds of casting, 25 mana): both provinces on either side of it are in sight for 1 minute.

TECHS.blurb: A Mage haunts the province he stands in (25 mana, no cooldown): you keep seeing it for 1 minute, even after he leaves.

TECHS.name: Bridge Building
TECHS.blurb: Masons can build a bridge across a river border (200 wood, 150 gold, 90 s). It takes no building plot, and only one of the two provinces has to be yours. Needs Stone Walls, Moat, the Forge and Refined Lumber Mills.

TECHS.name: Scout Sight
TECHS.blurb: Your scouts (Wayfinders, Scouts, Swampstriders) learn Scout Sight: after 5 seconds of focus a scout detects every unit in his field of vision, sneaking ones too, for as long as he holds still. He can’t move or sneak meanwhile: ordering him to move ends it.

TECHS.blurb: Your Crossbowmen trade the Hand-drawn Crossbow for the Lever Crossbow: attack 9 (from 6). Every Crossbowman you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.

TECHS.name: Windlass Crossbows

TECHS.name: Long Bows
TECHS.blurb: Your Archers trade the Composite Bow for the Long Bow: attack 12 (from 9). Every Archer you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.

roads.name: Dirt Roads
roads.blurb: Masons can build a dirt road across an open border (75 wood, 25 gold). Units move 25% faster along it.

walls.name: Wooden Walls
walls.blurb: Masons can close an open border with a wooden palisade (150 wood, 100 gold). Every wall has a gate that only its owner’s units can pass. Forts raise walls with gates on all their open borders.

stable.name: Building: Stable
stable.blurb: Unlocks the Stable, which lets a Barracks in the same province train Cavalry.

market.name: Building: Marketplace
market.blurb: Unlocks the Marketplace: +3 gold every payout, buildable in any province.

granary.name: Building: Granary
granary.blurb: Unlocks the Granary: +1000 food storage each (the nation starts able to hold 2000).

storehouse.name: Building: Storehouse
storehouse.blurb: Unlocks the Storehouse: +1000 wood storage each (the nation starts able to hold 2000).

bank.name: Building: Bank
bank.blurb: Unlocks the Bank: +1000 gold storage each (the nation starts able to hold 2000).

forts.name: Fort Charters I
forts.blurb: Raises the Fort limit from 1 to 3.

autoscout.name: Automating Wayfinders
autoscout.blurb: Idle Wayfinders survey explored, unsurveyed provinces on their own. Toggle it on a Wayfinder’s command card.

arrowslits.name: Arrowslits
arrowslits.blurb: Forts and capitals shoot at enemy armies standing in their province: one volley every 10 s, enough to bring down a Footman. An occupied fort stops shooting.

forge.name: Building: Forge
forge.blurb: Unlocks the Forge, which opens Military research. Owning a Barracks makes this technology 50% more likely to be offered.

retained.name: Retained Knowledge
retained.blurb: Every research tree (Government, Military and Magic) offers one more technology to choose from (4 instead of 3).

magetower.name: Building: Mage Tower
magetower.blurb: Unlocks the Mage Tower, which trains Mages and opens Magic research. Your first tower lets you choose a school of magic.

roads2.name: Gravel Roads
roads2.blurb: Every road is relaid in gravel: units move 35% faster along roads.

walls2.name: Stone Walls
walls2.blurb: Walls are built of stone, and existing palisades are rebuilt in stone: three times as strong.

forts2.name: Fort Charters II
forts2.blurb: Raises the Fort limit from 3 to 5.

stealth.name: Wayfinder Stealth
stealth.blurb: Wayfinders can sneak: three times slower, but enemy armies can’t see them. Without it, an enemy army that finds a Wayfinder kills him.

mushroom.name: Mushroom Farming
mushroom.blurb: Farms can be built in swamps too: damp, dark beds of mushrooms.

refmills.name: Refined Lumber Mills
refmills.blurb: Every Lumber Mill gives another +1 wood.

refmines.name: Refined Gold Mines
refmines.blurb: Every Gold Mine gives another +2 gold.

moat.name: Moat
moat.blurb: Your forts and capital are ringed with water: an enemy needs 10 seconds longer to capture them.

traderoutes.name: Trade Routes
traderoutes.blurb: Your capital makes +1 gold for every Marketplace it can reach by road, through any number of your provinces.

roads3.name: Cobblestone Roads
roads3.blurb: Every road is paved with cobbles: units move 50% faster along roads.

forts3.name: Fort Charters III
forts3.blurb: Raises the Fort limit from 5 to 7.

effadmin.name: Efficient Administration
effadmin.blurb: Every Fort (and your capital) allows 2 more provinces: 6 outposts each instead of 4.

autobuild.name: Master Builders
autobuild.blurb: Tier III+: offered once every other Tier III Government technology is done. Masons can be set to build one kind of building on their own, in every province that has room, whenever you can afford it.

farsight.name: Far-Seeing Wayfinders
farsight.blurb: Wayfinders see into every province next to the one they stand in, and every unexplored province they look into is explored for good.

sophmills.name: Sophisticated Lumber Mills
sophmills.blurb: Every Lumber Mill gives another +1 wood.

sophmines.name: Sophisticated Gold Mines

twohand.name: Two-Handed Grip
twohand.blurb: Protectors can be designed to fight two-handed (set the grip in the Armory): every other round they deal nothing, and the next a blow 2.5 times as hard, 125% of their damage over time. Champions fight this way without it.

school-life.name: School of Herbomancy
school-life.blurb: Commit to Herbomancy: harvests, protective skins, healing and the forest.

school-death.name: School of Necromancy
school-death.blurb: Commit to Necromancy: cursed weapons, mountain passages, the risen dead and grave riches.

school-arcane.name: School of the Arcane
school-arcane.blurb: Commit to Arcane magic: far sight from towers, mind reading, trading across worlds, traps and rifts.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.blurb: A Mage channels it for as long as he stands still: every Farm you own gives 10% more food. It drains 1 mana a second, and he regains none while channeling. One Mage casts it at a time.

bountiful.name: Bountiful Harvest
bountiful.blurb: Harvest makes Farms give 20% more food.

magnificent.name: Magnificent Harvest
magnificent.blurb: Harvest makes Farms give 30% more food.

apprentice.name: Apprentice
apprentice.blurb: Your Mage limit rises by 1: you can train a second Mage.

sanctum.name: Mage Sanctum
sanctum.blurb: Lets a Mage Tower be upgraded to a Mage Sanctum (Magic Tier II).

arcanum.name: Mage Arcanum
arcanum.blurb: Lets a Mage Sanctum be upgraded to a Mage Arcanum (Magic Tier III).

skin.name: Hardened Skin
skin.blurb: Autocast (50 mana, no cooldown): when an army with a Mage starts a battle, its soldiers get +5% health.

mending.name: Mending
mending.blurb: A Mage heals an army’s wounds back to full over 1 minute. 25 mana, no cooldown.

forest.name: Speak with the Forest
forest.blurb: A Mage standing in a province you own or occupy can open a path through a border of trees after 20 seconds of casting (200 mana). Lumber Mills are unaffected.

commune.name: Commune with Nature
commune.blurb: Opening a forest path takes 10 seconds.

arboreal.name: Arboreal Restoration
arboreal.blurb: A Mage can close a forest path again with 10 seconds of casting (200 mana).

terrascape.name: Terrascaping
terrascape.blurb: A Mage grows a line of trees along an open border, with a forest path left open in the middle: only a path through the trees remains. 5 minutes of casting, 100 mana.

curse1.name: Cursed Weapons I
curse1.blurb: Autocast (50 mana): when an army with a Mage starts a battle, its weapons deal +5% damage. 5-minute cooldown per army.

curse2.name: Cursed Weapons II
curse2.blurb: Cursed Weapons deal +10% damage; cooldown 3 minutes.

curse3.name: Cursed Weapons III
curse3.blurb: Cursed Weapons deal +15% damage; cooldown 90 seconds.

underworld.name: Underworld Passage
underworld.blurb: A Mage standing in a province you own or occupy can open a tunnel through a mountain border after 20 seconds of casting (200 mana).

hallways.name: Hallways of Pain
hallways.blurb: Opening a mountain tunnel takes 10 seconds.

sealed.name: Sealed Gates
sealed.blurb: A Mage can seal a mountain tunnel again with 10 seconds of casting (200 mana).

risen.name: Risen Dead
risen.blurb: Autocast: the first time a soldier of the army falls in a battle, the Mage spends 50 mana and the dead rise: that soldier and the next 4 to fall get straight back up, looking rather worse for it (same strength). Then it stops; when the battle ends it has a 2-minute cooldown. One Mage keeps this or Cursed Weapons ready, not both.

necro.name: Necromantic Energies
necro.blurb: Risen Dead raises 7 soldiers in a battle.

armyofdeath.name: Army of Death
armyofdeath.blurb: Risen Dead raises 10 soldiers in a battle.

graverob.name: Grave Robbing
graverob.blurb: A 3-second cast that spends all of the Mage’s mana: 1 gold for every point. Then the nation waits 3 minutes.

deathtax.name: Death Taxes
deathtax.blurb: Grave Robbing gives 2 gold for every point of mana.

charon.name: Charon’s Riches
charon.blurb: Grave Robbing gives 3 gold for every point of mana.

arcscouts.name: Arcane Scouts
arcscouts.blurb: Every Mage Tower (and its upgrades) sees all neighboring provinces, permanently.

arcvision.name: Arcane Vision
arcvision.blurb: Mage Towers reveal stealthed units within their sight.

clearthoughts.name: Clear Thoughts
clearthoughts.blurb: A 3-second cast (50 mana): every army within 3 provinces of the Mage is revealed for 20 seconds. 40-second cooldown.

mindread.name: Mind Reading
mindread.blurb: Clear Thoughts reveals every army on the map.

trading.name: Interdimensional Trading
trading.blurb: A 3-second cast that spends all of the Mage’s mana: 1 food, 1 gold and 1 wood for every 3 points. Then the nation waits 3 minutes.

stockmarket.name: Interdimensional Stockmarket
stockmarket.blurb: Trading gives 2 of each resource for every 3 points of mana.

planar.name: Planar Bazaar
planar.blurb: Trading gives 1 of each resource for every point of mana.

stasis.name: Stasis Trap
stasis.blurb: A Mage sets a trap in his province (3 seconds of casting, 50 mana); the next enemy army there can’t leave for 10 seconds (it can still fight). One trap at a time; no cooldown.

rift.name: Teleportation Rift
rift.blurb: Pick any explored province you may enter (your land, unclaimed land, or a nation you are at war or in a truce with): after 3 seconds of casting (100 mana) the Mage and his army are carried there. 2-minute cooldown for the nation.

grandstave.name: Grand Staves
grandstave.blurb: Mages can carry a Grand Stave: attack 6 (Stave 4), and every spell casts 10% faster while they carry it.

mythicstave.name: Mythic Staves
mythicstave.blurb: Mages can carry a Mythic Stave: attack 9, and every spell casts 20% faster while they carry it.

crypticwand.name: Cryptic Wands
crypticwand.blurb: Mages can carry a Cryptic Wand: attack 3 (Wand 2), leaving a hand free for a shield. Every spell costs 10% less mana while they carry it.

enigmaticwand.name: Enigmatic Wands
enigmaticwand.blurb: Mages can carry an Enigmatic Wand: attack 5, with a shield. Every spell costs 20% less mana while they carry it.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.blurb: A Mage standing in an enemy province your army occupies can cast an Earthquake (200 mana: it needs Magic Abundance): after 30 seconds every building in that province is destroyed, and every wall on its borders takes 120 wall damage (enough to bring down any wall).

school-pyro.name: School of Pyromancy
school-pyro.blurb: Commit to Pyromancy: fiery weapons, scouting pyres, fire traps, sacred pyres and paths of fire.

fiery1.name: Fiery Weapons I
fiery1.blurb: Autocast (50 mana, no cooldown): when an army with a Warlock starts a battle, every blow has a 5% chance to strike twice as hard.

fiery2.name: Fiery Weapons II
fiery2.blurb: Fiery Weapons: a 10% chance of a double blow.

fiery3.name: Fiery Weapons III
fiery3.blurb: Fiery Weapons: a 15% chance of a double blow.

scoutpyre.name: Scouting Pyre
scoutpyre.blurb: A Warlock lights a pyre where he stands (3 seconds of casting, 25 mana). For 1 minute it sees every neighboring province in its line of sight. 1-minute cooldown per Warlock.

firetrap.name: Fire Trap
firetrap.blurb: A Warlock buries a fire trap in his province (3 seconds of casting, 50 mana). The next enemy army to enter any part of that province is engulfed: 150 damage that ignores armor, to its front line. One trap per Warlock.

sacredpyre.name: Sacred Pyre
sacredpyre.blurb: A Warlock standing in one of your provinces raises a Sacred Pyre there (3 seconds of casting, 100 mana and 200 wood). For 1 minute that province makes 110 more gold every 10 s. Then the nation waits 3 minutes.

pathfire.name: Path of Fire
pathfire.blurb: A Warlock fires up his army (50 mana): 100% faster for 10 seconds. 1-minute cooldown per Warlock.

pathflame.name: Path of Flame
pathflame.blurb: Path of Fire: 125% faster for 15 seconds.

pathinferno.name: Path of Inferno
pathinferno.blurb: Path of Fire: 150% faster for 20 seconds.

school-elemental.name: School of the Elements
school-elemental.blurb: Commit to Elemental magic: rock armor, whispering rocks, forest spirits, town portals and a grand elemental of living water.

rockarmor.name: Rock Armor
rockarmor.blurb: Autocast (50 mana, no cooldown): when an army with a Druid starts a battle, plates of stone gather round it: a shield worth 10% of the army’s total health soaks up the damage before any soldier is hurt.

wrocks.name: Whispering Rocks
wrocks.blurb: A Druid raises whispering stones on a mountain border of the province he stands in (3 seconds of casting, 25 mana): both provinces on either side are in sight for 1 minute.

townportal.name: Town Portal
townportal.blurb: After 3 seconds of casting (100 mana), a Druid and the army he is in are carried to your capital. 5-minute cooldown per Druid.

forestspirit.name: Forest Spirit
forestspirit.blurb: A Druid channels a Forest Spirit into the province he stands in: while he keeps it up, the province makes twice the gold, wood, food and research. It drains 1 mana a second, and he regains none meanwhile.

gelemental.name: Grand Elemental
gelemental.blurb: A Druid summons a towering man of living water for 2 minutes (3 seconds of casting, 100 mana): 500 health, no armor, 50 damage a swing. He joins the Druid’s army (or forms one), fights, and can capture provinces. 5-minute cooldown per Druid.

skull-cracked.name: Cracked Skulls
skull-cracked.blurb: Warlocks with a wand can hold a Cracked Skull in the off hand: +1 attack, and the Fireball casts 2 s faster. Set it in the Armory.

skull-polished.name: Polished Skulls
skull-polished.blurb: Warlocks with a wand can hold a Polished Skull in the off hand: +2 attack, and the Fireball casts 4 s faster.

skull-flawless.name: Flawless Skulls
skull-flawless.blurb: Warlocks with a wand can hold a Flawless Skull in the off hand: +3 attack, and the Fireball casts 6 s faster.

abandon.name: Abandon Magic School
abandon.blurb: Costs 1000 gold to begin. When finished, your school and all of its spells are forgotten, and you can choose a new school.

rep-forts.baseBlurb: Raises the Fort limit by 2. Its cost never rises, and once offered it stays on offer.
rep-forts.name: Garrison Charters 1
rep-forts.blurb: Repeatable. Raises the Fort limit by 2. Its cost never rises, and once offered it stays on offer.

rep-admin.baseBlurb: Every Fort (and your capital) allows 2 more provinces.
rep-admin.name: Expand Administration 1
rep-admin.blurb: Repeatable. Every Fort (and your capital) allows 2 more provinces.

rep-storage.baseBlurb: Raises gold, wood and food storage by 500 each.
rep-storage.name: Deeper Cellars 1
rep-storage.blurb: Repeatable. Raises gold, wood and food storage by 500 each.

rep-trade.name: Merchant Guilds 1
rep-trade.blurb: Repeatable. Trade Routes give 5% more gold.

rep-lumber.name: Sawyer Guilds 1
rep-lumber.blurb: Repeatable. Lumber Mills give 5% more wood.

rep-masons.name: Masons’ Lodge 1
rep-masons.blurb: Repeatable. Raises the Mason limit by 1.

rep-wayfinders.name: Wayfinders’ Guild 1
rep-wayfinders.blurb: Repeatable. Raises the Wayfinder limit by 1.

rep-sword.name: Blade Mastery 1
rep-sword.blurb: Repeatable. Sword soldiers deal 5% more damage.
rep-sword.wdBlurb: Thrusting Sword soldiers deal 5% more damage.

rep-blunt.name: Crushing Blows 1
rep-blunt.blurb: Repeatable. Blunt weapons deal 5% more damage.

rep-pole.baseBlurb: Polearms (spears, pikes, polearms, halberds) deal 5% more damage.
rep-pole.name: Pike Drill 1
rep-pole.blurb: Repeatable. Polearms (spears, pikes, polearms, halberds) deal 5% more damage.

rep-armor.name: Tempered Armor 1
rep-armor.blurb: Repeatable. Body armor blocks 5% more damage.

rep-magecap.name: Mage Academy 1
rep-magecap.blurb: Repeatable. Raises the Mage limit by 1.

rep-harvest.baseBlurb: Harvest (at every rank) gives another 2% food from your Farms.
rep-harvest.name: Fertile Fields 1
rep-harvest.blurb: Repeatable. Harvest (at every rank) gives another 2% food from your Farms.

rep-graverob.baseBlurb: Grave Robbing (at every rank) yields 2% more gold.
rep-graverob.name: Deeper Graves 1
rep-graverob.blurb: Repeatable. Grave Robbing (at every rank) yields 2% more gold.

rep-trading.baseBlurb: Interdimensional Trading (at every rank) yields 2% more of each resource.
rep-trading.name: Planar Brokers 1
rep-trading.blurb: Repeatable. Interdimensional Trading (at every rank) yields 2% more of each resource.

rep-shockcast.baseBlurb: Shockwave takes 5% less time to cast.
rep-shockcast.name: Swift Shockwave 1
rep-shockcast.blurb: Repeatable. Shockwave takes 5% less time to cast.
rep-shockcast.swBlurb: Fireball takes 5% less time to cast.

rep-quakecast.baseBlurb: Earthquake takes 5% less time to cast.
rep-quakecast.name: Swift Earthquake 1
rep-quakecast.blurb: Repeatable. Earthquake takes 5% less time to cast.

rep-gelem.baseBlurb: The Grand Elemental hits 10% harder and has 10% more health.
rep-gelem.name: Deep Waters 1
rep-gelem.blurb: Repeatable. The Grand Elemental hits 10% harder and has 10% more health.

rep-rock.baseBlurb: Rock Armor’s stone shield holds 10% more damage.
rep-rock.name: Bedrock 1
rep-rock.blurb: Repeatable. Rock Armor’s stone shield holds 10% more damage.

rep-skin.baseBlurb: Hardened Skin (at every rank) gives 10% more extra health.
rep-skin.name: Living Bark 1
rep-skin.blurb: Repeatable. Hardened Skin (at every rank) gives 10% more extra health.

rep-curse.baseBlurb: Cursed Weapons (at every rank) give 10% more extra damage.
rep-curse.name: Lingering Curses 1
rep-curse.blurb: Repeatable. Cursed Weapons (at every rank) give 10% more extra damage.

rep-stasis.baseBlurb: Stasis traps hold an army 10% longer.
rep-stasis.name: Frozen Moments 1
rep-stasis.blurb: Repeatable. Stasis traps hold an army 10% longer.

rep-fiery.baseBlurb: Fiery Weapons (at every rank) are 10% more likely to strike a double blow.
rep-fiery.name: Searing Flames 1
rep-fiery.blurb: Repeatable. Fiery Weapons (at every rank) are 10% more likely to strike a double blow.

magicwell.name: Magic Well
magicwell.blurb: Your Magic Users can hold up to 150 mana (100 before).

magicabund.name: Magic Abundance
magicabund.blurb: Your Magic Users can hold up to 200 mana.

eyesforest.name: Eyes of the Forest
eyesforest.blurb: A Mage looks through a border of trees beside him (3 seconds of casting, 25 mana): both provinces on either side of it are in sight for 1 minute.

haunt.name: Haunt
haunt.blurb: A Mage haunts the province he stands in (25 mana, no cooldown): you keep seeing it for 1 minute, even after he leaves.

bridges.name: Bridge Building
bridges.blurb: Masons can build a bridge across a river border (200 wood, 150 gold, 90 s). It takes no building plot, and only one of the two provinces has to be yours. Needs Stone Walls, Moat, the Forge and Refined Lumber Mills.

scoutsight.name: Scout Sight
scoutsight.blurb: Your scouts (Wayfinders, Scouts, Swampstriders) learn Scout Sight: after 5 seconds of focus a scout detects every unit in his field of vision, sneaking ones too, for as long as he holds still. He can’t move or sneak meanwhile: ordering him to move ends it.

w-levercrossbow.name: Lever Crossbows
w-levercrossbow.blurb: Your Crossbowmen trade the Hand-drawn Crossbow for the Lever Crossbow: attack 9 (from 6). Every Crossbowman you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.

w-windlass.name: Windlass Crossbows
w-windlass.blurb: Your Crossbowmen trade the Lever Crossbow for the Windlass Crossbow: attack 12 (from 9). Every Crossbowman you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.

w-braidedsling.name: Braided Slings
w-braidedsling.blurb: Your Slingers trade the Wool Sling for the Braided Sling: attack 9 (from 6). Every Slinger you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.

w-leathersling.name: Leather Slings
w-leathersling.blurb: Your Slingers trade the Braided Sling for the Leather Sling: attack 12 (from 9). Every Slinger you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.

w-compositebow.name: Composite Bows
w-compositebow.blurb: Your Archers trade the Short Bow for the Composite Bow: attack 9 (from 6). Every Archer you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.

w-longbow.name: Long Bows
w-longbow.blurb: Your Archers trade the Composite Bow for the Long Bow: attack 12 (from 9). Every Archer you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.

gov.name: Government
gov.rate: Forts +2, Capital +3, Temples +2 per payout (outposts give none)

mil.name: Military
mil.locked: Research the Forge (Government Tier I), then build one to unlock Military research.
mil.rate: Forge +2, Battle Forge +4, War Forge +6 per payout

mag.name: Magic
mag.locked: Research the Mage Tower (Government Tier II), then build one to unlock Magic.
mag.rate: Mage Tower +2, Sanctum +4, Arcanum +6 per payout
